items.question: Does the document compute daily raw volume of about 1.38 TB/day (equivalently about 1.26 TiB/day; accept 1.2-1.5 TB)?
Does the document compute yearly raw volume of about 500 TB (accept 450-520 TB, or about 460 TiB)?
Does the hot-tier storage estimate explicitly include replica copies (e.g. x2 for one replica)?

Does the document point out that searchable snapshots (cold/frozen tier) require a paid Enterprise license and therefore conflict with the Basic-only constraint, proposing an alternative (e.g. snapshot + restore on request)?
Does the design guarantee integrity with a concrete mechanism (hash chain or signing of events/batches AND write-once storage such as S3 Object Lock/WORM snapshots)?
Does the design mask usernames/e-mails/phones in the ingest pipeline (Logstash or ingest node processors) before indexing?
Does the document define an ILM policy with rollover and phase transitions matching 30 days hot and 12 months total retention?
Does the document size the ingest layer for 20k EPS (number of Logstash/ingest nodes or bulk throughput per node with justification)?
